values.name: VAT, 1st value
values.description: First VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 1 to 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: VAT, 2nd value
values.description: Second VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 2 or 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: VAT, 3rd value
values.description: Third VAT value if, for the same rate of VAT, there are 3 different ways to set this value.

values.name: Additional royalties (Customs)
values.description: Royalties relating to the imported goods that the buyer must pay, either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale, to the extent that they are not included in the price actually paid or payable.

values.name: Adjusted amount
values.description: The amount specified is the adjusted amount.

values.name: Amount reference currency
values.description: The owing amount in the currency used as reference in the transaction.

values.name: Agreed charge
values.description: Charges which parties agreed upon.

values.name: Allowance or charge amount
values.description: [5422] Total amount of allowance or charge.

values.name: Amount due/amount payable
values.description: Amount to be paid.

values.name: Amount in charge currency
values.description: Indicates that the amount is based on the charged currency.

values.name: Amount remitted
values.description: Amount which was remitted (see remittance advice).

values.name: Amount subject to total monetary discount
Amount target currency
values.description: The amount in the currency in which the amount is paid or has to be paid.

values.name: Average ledger balance
values.description: The addition of the balance all accounts divided by the number of accounts.

values.name: Batch total
values.description: The complete quantity of anything needed for or made in one operation or lot.

values.name: Brokerage
values.description: Fee charged by a broker for acting on behalf of a third party.

values.name: Buying commission
values.description: Commission paid by the importer to his/her agent for the service of representing him/her in the purchase.

values.name: Data value on carrier media (Customs)
values.description: Value of data contained on the carrier media (e.g. magnetic tape).

values.name: Cash discount
values.description: Cash discount given by the seller to the buyer where payment is made in advance of receipt of goods.

values.name: Cash on delivery amount
values.description: Amount to be collected by carrier upon delivery of goods. This amount represents approximately the value of the goods.

values.name: Charge summary total
values.description: Code to indicate the total charges relating to a consignment.

values.name: Charge/allowance basis
values.description: The amount specified is the basis for calculation of charges/allowance.

values.name: Charges in destination currency
values.description: Collect charges payable in the currency of the country of destination.

values.name: Collect charges in destination currency
values.description: Collect charges payable in the currency of the country of destination.

values.name: Collect freight charge including VAT
values.description: This is the total amount that has to be collected from the consignee or other intermediary intervening party - Including VAT-.

values.name: Collect freight charge without VAT
values.description: For legal accounting reasons the amount without VAT has to be announced, together with the amount of VAT.

values.name: Collect other charges due agent total
Collected balance required
values.description: A certain sum of money that must be kept in an account.

values.name: Container cost
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Converted amount
values.description: The amount is converted from another currency.

values.name: Credit on consignment
values.description: Credit deducted from the total invoice amount for the value of goods not included in a consignment but included in the invoice.

values.name: Invoice item amount
values.description: (5068) Total sum charged in respect of a single Invoice item in accordance with the terms of delivery.

values.name: Invoice total amount
values.description: [5444] Total sum charged in respect of one or more Invoices in accordance with the terms of delivery.

values.name: Customs value
values.description: (5032) Value declared for Customs purposes on those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same Customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

values.name: Assigned Customs value
values.description: Goods value assigned by Customs.

values.name: Total cash payments received by factor
values.description: Total allocated amount of cash payments received by a factor.

values.name: Declared total Customs value
values.description: [5070] Total value declared for Customs purposes of all goods in a consignment, whether or not they are subject to the same Customs procedure, or have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information, and duty regime.

values.name: Declared value for carriage
values.description: (5036) Value, declared by the shipper or his agent solely for the purpose of varying the carrier's level of liability from that provided in the contract of carriage, in case of loss or damage to goods or delayed delivery.

values.name: Deductible after importation charges (Customs)
values.description: Charges (e.g. construction, assembly, erection, maintenance or technical assistance) after importation, which are included in the total invoice price, that may be deducted to arrive at a Customs value.

values.name: Deductions (Customs)
values.description: [5020] Allowable deductions from the Customs value basis used.

values.name: Delivery fee
values.description: Fees incurred by delivery.

values.name: Deposit total
values.description: The whole amount of money that one entrusts for safekeeping.

values.name: Development necessary for production of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Value of engineering, development, artwork, design work and plans and sketches carried out elsewhere than in the Customs territory and necessary for the production of the imported goods.

values.name: Disbursements
values.description: Amount of disbursements to be collected by the carrier according to the order given by the shipper.

values.name: Disbursements fee
values.description: Fee charged for the collection of disbursements.

values.name: Discount amount
values.description: The amount specified is the discount amount.

values.name: Duty/tax/fee basis amount
values.description: The amount specified is the basis for duty/tax or fee.

values.name: Equivalent amount
values.description: This amount is equivalent to the amount to be transferred, but in another currency.

values.name: Fees paid year to date
values.description: Payments made for goods thus far.

values.name: Final (posted) amount
values.description: The amount posted to an account, finally, after charges/allowances.

values.name: Float (e.g. "cash float")
values.description: The status of funds in the process of collection.

values.name: Total payments on account received by a factor
values.description: Total unallocated amount of payments received by a factor.

values.name: FOB value
values.description: Identifies the value of the shipment free on board, named port of shipment (see FOB Incoterm of ICC).

values.name: Freight charge
values.description: Amount to be paid for moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another, inclusive discounts, allowances, rebates, adjustment factors and additional cost relating to freight costs (UN/ECE Recommendation no 23).

values.name: Total indirect amount payments made to a seller or his agent instead of to a factor
values.description: Total indirect amount of payments made to a seller or his agent instead of to a factor.

values.name: Goods item total
values.description: Net price x quantity for the line item.

values.name: Insurance and transport charges (Customs)
values.description: (5488)+(5292) Sum total of transport and insurances charges (CCC).

values.name: Insurance and transport charges incurred outside Customs territory
values.description: (5488)+(5292) Insurance and transport charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Insurance charges (Customs)
values.description: [5488] Amount of premium payable to the insurance company to insure the goods to the port or place of importation.

values.name: Insurance charges incurred outside of Customs territory
values.description: (5488) Insurance charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Internal charges (Customs)
values.description: Charges incurred within a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Total amount of payments booked to the collateral account
values.description: Total amount of payments booked to the collateral account.

values.name: Amount to be paid in advance
values.description: Amount which is to be paid before goods are delivered or the service is rendered.

values.name: Registered capital
values.description: Registered amount of equity of a company.

values.name: Investable balance
values.description: To put left over money in something offering profitable returns.

values.name: Invoice amount
values.description: [5068] Total sum charged in respect of a single Invoice in accordance with the terms of delivery.

values.name: Landing charges
values.description: The charges incurred in landing the goods into store in the country of importation, excluding Customs duties and taxes.

values.name: Total line items amount
values.description: The sum of all the line item amounts.

values.name: Licence fees related to imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Licence fees relating to the imported goods that the buyer must pay, either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale, to the extent that they are not included in the price actually paid or payable.

values.name: Loading and handling cost
values.description: Cost incurred by loading and handling.

values.name: Lock box total
values.description: The complete amount of funds that customers mailed in to a specific location. Often times funds are sent to a post- office lock box in their city.

values.name: Lumpsum
values.description: An agreed sum of money, which is paid in full at one time. This term is often used in connection with charter parties.

values.name: Material consumed in production of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Value of materials consumed in the production of the imported goods.

values.name: National preference basis amount
values.description: Amount giving the basis for national preference calculation.

values.name: Negative collected balance
values.description: Having a quantity of less than zero in an account.

values.name: Negative ledger balance
values.description: For an asset account, this would be when the account had a credit balance. For liability and owner's equity accounts, it would be when the account had a debit balance.

values.name: Net adjustment
values.description: The end-of-the-period total amount which is left after recording appropriate adjusting entries.

values.name: Net fee position
values.description: The payments left over after deductions or allowances have been made.

values.name: Net year to date excess (deficit)
values.description: A negative amount of an item.

values.name: No amount of insurance
values.description: No amount of insurance has been declared for a consignment.

values.name: No declared value for carriage
values.description: No value has been declared for purposes of carriage.

values.name: No declared value for Customs
values.description: No value has been declared for Customs purposes.

values.name: Offer amount
values.description: [5210] Total amount of an offer.

values.name: Original amount
values.description: Original amount, without charges, allowances or adjustment.

values.name: Other charges at destination
values.description: Code to indicate charges levied at destination.

values.name: Other charges due agent
values.description: Code to indicate that certain charges accrue to an agent.

values.name: Other charges due carrier
values.description: Code to indicate that certain charges accrue to a carrier.

values.name: Other commissions
values.description: Other commissions paid by the importer to his/her agent in relation to the goods being imported.

values.name: Other deductible charges
values.description: Other charges deducted from the total invoice value.

values.name: Other transport charges
values.description: (5292) Other charges paid for transport.

values.name: Other valuation charges (Customs)
values.description: Other valuation charges which are payable by reason of the importation or sale of the goods in the Customs territory.

values.name: Packing cost
values.description: Cost for packing concerning labour and/or material.

values.name: Packing cost (Customs)
values.description: [5448] Costs incurred for all containers and coverings of whatever nature which are considered as being one for Customs purposes with the goods, and the cost of packing whether for labour or material.

values.name: Parts incorporated in imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Materials, components, parts and similar items incorporated in the imported goods.

values.name: Payment discount amount
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Pick-up fee
values.description: Fee incurring if item has been or will be picked up.

values.name: Positive collected balance
values.description: Having a quantity of greater than zero in an account.

values.name: Positive ledger balance
values.description: For an asset account, this would be when the account had a debit balance. For liability and owner's equity accounts, it would be when the account had a credit balance.

values.name: Prepaid amount
values.description: (5302) Amount which has been prepaid in advance.

values.name: Prepaid charge summary total
values.description: Total of all prepaid charges.

values.name: Prepaid taxes total
values.description: Total of all prepaid taxes.

values.name: Purchase amount
values.description: The cost of buying goods or services.

values.name: Quantity discount
values.description: Discount given for purchase of goods in bulk.

values.name: Quota value
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Received amount
values.description: The amount is what the bank received, and the one before charges/allowances.

values.name: Sales tax
values.description: Identifies the amount of sales tax payable.

values.name: Shipment value in domestic currency
values.description: The cost of transportation in domestic currency.

values.name: Specific amount payable
values.description: Amount that the consignor agrees to be invoiced or to pay. This amount is part of the total charges applied to the consignment.

values.name: Statistical value
values.description: [5218] Value declared for statistical purposes of those goods in a consignment which have the same statistical heading and country of origin.

values.name: Tax amount
values.description: Tax imposed by government or other official authority related to the weight/volume charge or valuation charge.

values.name: To collect
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Tools used in production of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Tools, dies, moulds and similar items used in the production of the imported goods.

values.name: Total amount
values.description: The amount specified is the total amount.

values.name: Total amount subject to payment discount
values.description: Part of the invoice amount which is subject to payment discount.

values.name: Total charge due
values.description: Total amount of charges payable to the carrier.

values.name: Total charges/allowances
values.description: The amount specified is the total of all charges/allowances.

values.name: Total collect charges
values.description: Total charges to be collected.

values.name: Total collect charges at destination
values.description: Total charges to be collected at destination.

values.name: Total declared
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Total freight due
values.description: Total amount of freight costs payable to the carrier.

values.name: Total invoice additional amount
values.description: (5140) Amount to be added to the sum of invoice line amounts to arrive at the total invoice amount.

values.name: Total monetary discount amount
values.description: Total of monetary discount amounts.

values.name: Total payment amount
values.description: A complete charge for goods or services rendered.

values.name: Total service charge
values.description: The complete payment owed to one who has performed work for another.

values.name: Cost, insurance and freight (CIF) value
values.description: Identifies the value of cost, insurance and freight. (Refer to ICC Incoterm CIF for an expanded definition).

values.name: Trade discount
values.description: Discount given to any purchaser at a particular commercial level e.g. at wholesale or retail level.

values.name: Transfer amount
values.description: The amount which has been transferred from buyer to the sellers bank.

values.name: Transport charges (Customs)
values.description: (5292) Cost incurred by shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage, see UN/ECE Recommendation No 23. Synonym: freight charges (Customs).

values.name: Transport charges incurred outside Customs territory
values.description: (5292) Transport charges incurred outside a Customs territory (or a Customs union).

values.name: Unit price
values.description: (5110) Reporting monetary amount is a "per unit" amount.

values.name: Acceptable quotation fluctuation amount
values.description: The maximum increase or decrease in constituent material fluctuation which will not result in an item price renegotiation.

values.name: Total payments under guarantee
values.description: Total amount paid under guarantee, such as under a factor's guarantee.

values.name: Valuation charge
values.description: A charge based on the value of goods or cargo.

values.name: Value added tax
values.description: [5490] Amount in national currency resulting from the application, at the appropriate rate, of value added tax (or similar tax) to the invoice amount subject to such tax.

values.name: Value insured
values.description: Representation in figures of the total sum covered by an insurance for a particular shipment.

values.name: Subsequent resale of imported goods (Customs)
values.description: Value of any part of the proceeds of any subsequent resale, disposal or use of the imported goods that accrues, directly or indirectly, to the seller.

values.name: Weight charge
values.description: A charge based on the weight of goods or cargo.

values.name: Standard duty
values.description: Standard Customs duty that would apply if special provisions did not apply.

values.name: G-Amount
values.description: Amount out of total invoice amount being paid into a blocked account.

values.name: Insurance value
values.description: (5010) Value for which the goods are insured.

values.name: Insurance and transport charges incurred inside Customs territory
values.description: (5488)+(5292) Charges to be paid for moving goods, by whatever means, from the point of entry into the Customs territory (within a Customs union: to the point of entry in the final destination country).

values.name: Licence (value deducted)
values.description: Amount in the currency of the licence to be written off from the total licence value.

values.name: Other costs
values.description: (5346) Costs, other than packing, freight and insurance costs, specified separately.

values.name: Duty, tax or fee amount
values.description: Amount of duty, tax or fee.

values.name: Customs duty paid
values.description: Amount which can be deducted from the stated invoice price where that price includes the Customs duty amount.

values.name: Wage tax share
values.description: Wage tax share of total amount to be paid directly to tax collector.

values.name: Social securities premiums share
values.description: Social securities share of total amount to be paid directly to the social securities collector.

values.name: Adjustment amount
values.description: Amount being the balance of the amount to be adjusted and the adjusted amount.

values.name: Guarantee amount (Customs)
values.description: Amount of the guarantee placed with Customs.

values.name: Actual versus calculated price difference
values.description: Difference between actual and calculated price.

values.name: Alternate currency total amount
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Document amount
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Total reassignments of factored invoices
values.description: Total amount of factored invoices and credit notes reassigned to the seller or to another factor.

values.name: Stated amount
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Minimum amount
values.description: Lowest possible value; minimum.

values.name: Balance brought forward
values.description: Opening balance of the account brought forward from the prior accounting period.

values.name: Message total additional amount
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Message total duty/tax/fee amount
values.description: Total of all duty/tax/fee amounts.

values.name: Message total amount prepaid
values.description: Total of all prepaid amounts within the message.

values.name: Exact amount
values.description: Specific amount.

values.name: Maximum amount
values.description: Highest possible value; maximum.

values.name: Amount up to
values.description: Highest possible value; up to.

values.name: Amount not exceeding
values.description: Highest possible value; not exceeding.

values.name: Any other specification/tolerance
values.description: Any further qualification of the amount.

values.name: No specification/tolerance
values.description: No further qualification of the amount.

values.name: Raw material per unit of measure cost
Total material including purchased components cost
Line item amount
values.description: Goods item total minus allowances plus charges for line item. See also Code 66.

values.name: Additional amount covered: freight costs
values.description: Additional amount (freight costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: inspection costs
values.description: Additional amount (inspection costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: insurance costs
values.description: Additional amount (insurance costs) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Additional amount covered: interest
values.description: Additional amount (interest) which is also covered under the documentary credit.

values.name: Agent commission amount
values.description: Amount which has to be paid to an agent.

values.name: Credit note amount
values.description: Amount of a credit note.

values.name: Debit note amount
values.description: Amount of a debit note.

values.name: Documentary credit amount
values.description: Amount of the documentary credit.

values.name: Part of documentary credit amount
values.description: Part of documentary credit amount subject to sight payment, deferred payment or acceptance when the documentary credit is available by mixed payment.

values.name: Advance payment at the beginning of works
values.description: Amount paid to the contractor at the beginning of works in the construction to be deducted later.

values.name: Deduction of advance payment amount at the beginning of works
values.description: Progressive deduction of advance payment, as works go on.

values.name: Advance payment amount on building material
Deduction of the advance payment amount on building material
Deduction of the advance payment amount on stock
Amount subject to guarantee retention
values.description: Amount participating in the assessment basis of a guarantee retention.

values.name: Amount not subject of guarantee retention
values.description: Amount not participating in the assessment basis of a guarantee retention.

values.name: Amount subject to contractual retention
values.description: Amount participating in the assessment basis of a contractual retention.

values.name: Works amount, initial
values.description: Total amount of works in the initial contract.

values.name: Works amount, variations
values.description: Total amount of contract variations, not including the amount planned on initial contract.

values.name: Works amount, total
values.description: Total amount of works, including initial contract and variations.

values.name: Deposit
values.description: Part of the amount of retention, not covered by guarantee of retention, and thus deducted from the amount paid to the contractor until release of retention.

values.name: Deposit refund
values.description: Refund of deposit, due to an increase of the guarantee of retention amount, or a decrease of the amount of retention.

values.name: Guarantee on retention refund
values.description: Refund of deposit, due to partial or complete release of retention.

values.name: Amount subject to escalation
values.description: Amount which is used as the basis for the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount subject to escalation, initial
values.description: Amount in the initial contract which is used as the basis for the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount of variations subject to escalation
values.description: Amount of variations which is used as the basis for the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount not subject to escalation
values.description: Amount which is not included in the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount not subject to escalation, initial
values.description: Amount in the initial contract which is not included in the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount of variations not subject to escalation
values.description: Amount of variations which is not included in the calculation of the escalation.

values.name: Amount subject to price adjustment
values.description: Amount which is used as the basis for price adjustment calculation.

values.name: Amount subject to price adjustment, initial
values.description: Amount in the initial contract which is used as the basis for the price adjustment calculation.

values.name: Amount of variations subject to price adjustment
values.description: Amount of variations which is used as the basis for price adjustment calculation.

values.name: Amount not subject to price adjustment
values.description: Amount which is not included in the calculation of the price adjustment.

values.name: Amount not subject to price adjustment, initial
values.description: Amount in the initial contract which is not included in the calculation of the price adjustment.

values.name: Amount of variations not subject to price adjustment
values.description: Amount of variations which is not included in the calculation of the price adjustment.

values.name: Escalation amount
values.description: Difference between initial amount and current amount.

values.name: Provisional escalation amount
values.description: Difference between initial amount and provisional current amount.

values.name: Price adjustment amount
values.description: Difference between initial amount and revised amount.

values.name: Provisional price adjustment amount
values.description: Difference between initial amount and provisional revised amount.

values.name: Price revaluation amount
values.description: Amount of escalation and price adjustment.

values.name: Provisional price revaluation amount
values.description: Provisional amount of escalation and price adjustment.

values.name: Contractual retention amount total
values.description: Retention on a basis contractually fixed.

values.name: Valuation amount
values.description: Amount of valuation.

values.name: Deduction amount of direct payments to subcontractors
values.description: Deduction of amounts directly paid to subcontractors.

values.name: Amortization total amount
values.description: Indication of final monetary amount for amortization.

values.name: Amortization order amount
values.description: Indication of actual share of the monetary amount for amortization.

values.name: Amortization cumulated amount
values.description: Indication of actual cumulated monetary amount of previous and actual amortization order amount.

values.name: Current credit cover
values.description: Limit for current credit cover.

values.name: New credit cover
values.description: Limit for new credit cover.

values.name: Order cover
values.description: Credit cover for an individual order or shipment.

values.name: Amount subject to dispute
values.description: The amount that is being disputed.

values.name: Charge amount for information
values.description: The stated charge amount is only for information. The amount will be debited due to agreement.

values.name: Total charges
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Total allowances
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Alternate currency amount
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Instalment amount
values.description: Amount paid or due for a single instalment of an instalment payment scheme.

values.name: Outstanding amount
values.description: Amount still remaining outstanding for payment.

values.name: Gross contribution amount
values.description: Gross amount contributed. This may include commissions or allowances.

values.name: Commission amount
values.description: Amount of any commission.

values.name: Net contribution amount
values.description: Amount contributed net of any commission or other allowances .

values.name: Regular contribution amount
values.description: Specified contribution amount regularly paid.

values.name: Previous regular contribution amount
values.description: Specified contribution amount regularly paid before a change .

values.name: Variation amount
values.description: Difference from a nominated amount.

values.name: Notional salary
values.description: A salary amount specified for a particular category of employees.

values.name: Nominal salary
values.description: The salary amount without special allowances or other cash benefits.

values.name: Taxable salary
values.description: The salary amount which is taxable.

values.name: Superannuation salary
values.description: Salary used for superannuation benefit/contribution purposes .

values.name: Total remuneration
values.description: The amount of the total value of a person's remuneration.

values.name: Other salary
values.description: The amount of other salary or allowances in addition to a base salary.

values.name: Annual salary
values.description: Self-explanatory.

values.name: Total contributions amount
values.description: Sum of individual contributions.

values.name: Voluntary contribution amount
values.description: The amount is for a non-compulsory contribution.

values.name: Instalment first amount
values.description: First of a number of due amounts if payment by instalment is agreed.

values.name: Instalment current amount
values.description: Current amount of a number of due amounts if payment by instalment is agreed.

values.name: Instalment last amount
values.description: Last of a number of due amounts if payment by instalment is agreed.

values.name: Current maintenance fee
values.description: Current amount of a number of amounts due on maintenance contract.

values.name: Current leasing fee
values.description: Current amount of a number of amounts due on lease contracts.

values.name: Day works amount
values.description: The amount of work calculated on the basis of manpower time and supply cost.

values.name: Manufacturer's bonus
values.description: Allowance given as a manufacturer's bonus.

values.name: Administration charge
values.description: Charge made for an administration activity.

values.name: Fuel charge
values.description: Charge relating to fuel supplied.

values.name: Registration plate charge
values.description: The charge relating to the normal supply of vehicle registration plates.

values.name: Subtotal amount
values.description: Total amount of money that is part of a complete amount.

values.name: Dumping export value
values.description: The export value calculated for the purposes of assessing dumping duty.

values.name: Foreign inland freight
values.description: The amount of inland freight incurred in delivering the goods to the place of export.

values.name: Concession amount
values.description: The amount of any concession. To allow the nomination of the difference between the amount of duty plus tax paid and the amount that would have been payable without an end-use security being applied.

values.name: Chargeback
values.description: Invoice amount charged back to seller.

values.name: Charge per credit cover
values.description: Unit charge per credit cover established.

values.name: Charge per unused credit cover
values.description: Unit charge per unused credit cover.

values.name: Total authorised deduction
values.description: Total amount of authorised deductions from payment of invoices.

values.name: Total chargebacks
values.description: Total amount charged back to the seller.

values.name: Total offsets
values.description: Total amount offset against other items on the seller's or buyer's account.

values.name: Total special entries
values.description: Total amount to be treated as special booking entry by the beneficiary.

values.name: Balance carried forward
values.description: Closing balance of the account to be carried forward to the next accounting period.

values.name: Total outstanding invoices past due
values.description: Total amount of outstanding invoices past due.

values.name: Off balance disputed items
values.description: Total amount of disputed invoices/credit notes.

values.name: Commission invoices
values.description: Amount of commission invoices.

values.name: Other charges
values.description: Miscellaneous charges.

values.name: Amount remittances
values.description: Amount of money remitted.
